title: Weekday-conditioned number inclusion beyond pooled frequency
hypothesis: The weekday known before a target may condition number inclusion rates beyond a pooled historical frequency model. A weekday-conditioned fixed-size 5-of-40 subset distribution may improve joint subset log-loss and marginal inclusion Brier over both uniform and pooled-frequency baselines.

definitions.draw: D_t is a five-element subset of {1,...,40}.
definitions.weekday: UTC weekday computed from the target's ISO calendar date; known before the draw.
definitions.global_rate: p_i=(alpha*p0+C_i)/(alpha+N), where N is prior draw count, C_i prior appearances of number i, p0=5/40.
definitions.weekday_rate: p_i,d=(alpha*p_i+C_i,d)/(alpha+N_d), where N_d is the number of prior draws on weekday d and C_i,d is the number of prior appearances of i on weekday d.
definitions.weights: w_i=exp(logit(p_i)-logit(p0)) for M1; w_i,d=exp(logit(p_i,d)-logit(p0)) for M2.
definitions.subset_distribution: P(S|x)=product_{i in S}w_i / e_5(w_1,...,w_40), over every five-number subset.

models.M1: Pooled number-frequency model with fixed alpha=200 shrinkage toward p0=0.125.
models.M2: Weekday-conditioned number-frequency model with fixed alpha=200 shrinkage toward the pooled M1 rates; target weekday is known ex ante.

design.update_order: For each target, compute weekday and estimate all rates from strictly prior draws; score target before updating global and weekday counts with its outcome.
design.parameter_tuning: None; alpha=200 fixed in this protocol. No model/weekday subgroup search.
design.primary_metric: Joint five-subset log-loss under exact fixed-size normalization; lower is better.
design.secondary_metric: Mean marginal Bernoulli Brier score over 40 number-inclusion probabilities; lower is better.

inference.gain_direction: Baseline loss minus model loss; positive favors the model.
inference.multiple_testing: Holm across all 12 predeclared validation and historical Blind OOS endpoints.

limitations: This is an exploratory hypothesis within a large cumulative Q00-Q139 research family; Holm covers only the 12 predeclared Q139 holdout endpoints, not the full historical research family.
The historical Blind OOS has been exposed to prior SONAR research and is not a virgin prospective holdout.
The walk-forward is a strict-prior historical reconstruction, not a contemporaneous forecast freeze.
Weekday is an exogenous calendar covariate; the experiment does not establish a causal weekday mechanism.
The disputed 2026-11-11 draw is excluded because its five-number primary-source provenance remains unresolved.
No model can guarantee or establish a winning quintet.
next_action: If weekday conditioning fails to improve on the pooled frequency model on historical Blind OOS after Holm correction, retain M0 as reference and M1/M2 as research controls; prioritize source-clean prospective freezes rather than further calendar or lag variants.
